name: 果穂
text: えっ！　ほんとですかっ！

name: 果穂
text:
銀河をつなぐ黒猫列車、
本日ひとりめのお客様がご乗車ですっ……────
trans:
Today, we have one passenger boarding the Kuroneko
Express: The railroad connecting you to the galaxy...

name: プロデューサー
text:
────車検の書類は出したし……
勤怠と経費申請は明日でいいとして……
trans:
────I submitted the inspection papers... and
I hope that they let me submit my absence and
expense reports tomorrow...

name: プロデューサー
text:
……はぁ……
なんとか帰れてよかった……──
trans:
...Hah...
I'm so glad I was able to make it home...──

name: プロデューサー
text:
…………
乗り過ごしたんじゃ……ないのか……────？

name: 果穂
text: きっぷを拝見しまーす！

name: 智代子
text: みんな天の川に行っちゃったのかな？
trans: I guess everyone got off at the Milky Way?

name: 樹里
text:
そりゃ、ハロウィンだからな
今ごろハイタッチとかしてんじゃねーの
trans:
I mean, it is Halloween. They're all probably high-fiving
and stuff right about now.

name: 智代子
text:
だよね、確かに……
きっとすっごく混んでるよね……！
trans:
Oh yeah, you're probably right... It was insanely
packed though, wasn't it...!?

name: 樹里
text:
──と、チョコ
次のカーブ、揺れるぞ
trans:
──Oh hey, Choco, we're gonna be pumpin' at the next
curve.

name: 智代子
text: あ、うん！　ありがとう！
trans: Oh, okay! Thanks for letting me know!

name: 樹里
trans: ────Told ya we didn't have to worry.

name: 樹里
text:
帰りのお客をゲットすればいいだろ！
車掌は、ベガのあたりまで行くってさ
trans:
Nice that we're getting some customers who're
heading home. The conductor said to go all the way
out to Vega.

name: 智代子
text:
えっ、ベガ！？
結構攻めるね……！？
trans:
Huh, VEGA!?
We're really going for it, huh...!?

name: 樹里
text: まぁな。難所には違いねーよ
trans: I guess so yeah. It's a pretty rough road there.

name: 樹里
text:
けど、だからこその名物スポットだ
乗車率180パーは固い
trans:
But, that's why it's so famous after all. We can
reliably get 180% increased customers if we go.

name: 樹里
text: 今月もかっつかつだからなー……
trans: We've had great numbers this month too...

name: 智代子
text:
そうだね……
いっぱい乗ってもらわなきゃ……
trans: Yeah we have... We need a lot of rides as it is.

name: 智代子
text:
──よーし！
そしたら私も頑張ってくるよ！
trans: ──Alright! I'm gonna do my best too!

name: 智代子
text: 車内販売、行ってまいります！
trans: I'm gonna go out and sell some treats!

name: 樹里
text:
おー
頼むぜ、チョコ！
trans:
Cool──
Good luck out there, Choco!

name: 樹里
text:
……うしっ
こっちもウデ見せてやろうじゃねーの
trans: ...Alright. I gotta prove my worth here too.

name: 樹里
trans:
──Looking at the timetable, we should be arriving
to Serpens Station right on time.

name: 樹里
text:
夜を駆けるなら、
暗闇の眷属にお任せだ
trans:
We're gonna get a bunch of night owls if we run
through the night.

name: プロデューサー
text:
その……
切符っていうか、これは定期券なんだけど……
trans:
Um... I don't really have a ticket, would a commuter
pass work...?

name: 果穂
trans: I've never seen this kind of ticket before...

name: 果穂
text:
警備隊さんがくるまで、
車しょう室にお願いしますっ！
trans:
Please come with me to the conductor's quarters
until security arrives!

name: プロデューサー
text:
果──
じゃないんだっけか……ええと────！
trans: Kaho── Wait, are you...? Hey, um────!

name: 果穂
text:
どうぞこちらへ！
足元にお気を付けくださいっ！
trans: Right this way, sir! Please watch your step!

name: 千雪
text:
うん
さっきの方の言ってた通りなら……
trans: Yes. If what we were told is correct...

name: 甘奈
trans:
..."Next stop, Serpens Station, headed towards the
Milky Way".
